description: Legacy gate names may be mistaken for framework v1.1 passage
existing_controls: Historical evidence preserved; v1.1 gap report created
further_controls: Re-baseline gates and require evidence-mapped independent review
verification_method: Independent gate mapping and approval review

description: Further staged falls could cause injury or constitute unapproved human research
further_controls: Obtain institutional determination and approved protocol with screening spotter stopping rules and incident response

description: CARAT could transmit OTA without a complete current ACMA and EME approval record
existing_controls: CARAT was stopped; new profile is disabled; Makefile hardware execution removed
further_controls: Implement a deny-by-default signed RF profile verifier with expiry EIRP location antenna duty-cycle owner and exclusive-lock checks

description: Legacy 5.8 GHz operation used antennas labelled for 2.4-2.5 GHz
existing_controls: Legacy 5.8 GHz profile stopped and disabled
further_controls: Inventory components; use only frequency-rated antennas under an approved RF profile
verification_method: Physical inventory and signed RF profile review

description: Medical-device applicability is unresolved while clinical monitoring and prediction are contemplated
further_controls: Formal claim-specific TGA determination and standards applicability matrix

description: A missed fall or low recall could delay response or create false reassurance
existing_controls: Development-only intended use; no clinical alerts approved
further_controls: Quality gating abstention event-level realistic-prevalence validation local fallback and no-alert caveat

description: False fall alerts could cause anxiety unnecessary response or alarm fatigue
further_controls: Define alert budget hard-negative testing PPV and false alerts per resident-day and human-factors validation

description: RF-derived movement and occupancy may expose intimate behaviour or bystanders
existing_controls: Raw IQ is excluded from Git; dashboard does not intentionally serve raw IQ
further_controls: Approve PIA coded IDs zones pause/status retention encryption RBAC withdrawal and export controls
verification_method: Approved PIA and privacy control tests

description: Unauthenticated HTTP/WebSocket dashboard may disclose derived data or future clinical context
further_controls: Bind development UI locally; add authentication RBAC TLS origin policy session revocation and tests

description: Participant session or window leakage or unknown provenance could inflate results
existing_controls: Session-level labels exist; manifest syntax drafted
further_controls: Create immutable split manifest before windowing and perform duplicate provenance and label-quality audit

description: Proposal claims local bench results and clinical evidence may be conflated
further_controls: Maintain source confidence limitations dates claim links and independent review

description: CARAT or RF-FAST may be presented as an approved product or study name without authority
further_controls: Obtain explicit naming approval source scope trademark and partner review and migration record

description: Mutable CSV/JSONL logs may omit durations or be changed without detection
existing_controls: Existing logs retained; Phase 0 evidence will be checksummed
further_controls: Append-only durable audit with actor correlation approvals step events hash linkage and redaction

description: CARAT lacks an enforced exclusive N210 ownership lock
further_controls: Host-enforced ownership and idempotent state transition before any CARAT hardware access

description: Dashboard WebSocket handlers can block shutdown when upstream ZMQ publishers disappear
further_controls: Cancellation-aware receive loop bounded shutdown upstream-loss handling and orphan-process test
